'''Tarula''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Dug/Legends|Dug]], who lived during the early years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Byrsym]], where he worked for the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] merchant [[Ballon]]. When a group of agents from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Daimar]] attempted to contact Ballon while in the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] [[Emthuul's]], Tarula sat at the cantina's bar and watched over Ballon, without making it obvious what he was doing.

==Personality and traits==
Tarula pretended to be stupid and pugnacious to get people to underestimate him. However, he was in fact shrewd, competent and very practical.
